blocks.raw: <Tip>Memory aid: Engineered quartz = best all-rounder (hard, non-porous, low-maintenance). Natural granite = durable but requires sealing. Marble = beautiful but high-maintenance (etching risk). Laminate = budget-friendly but short-lived. Concrete = artistic but labor-intensive. Match material to maintenance tolerance, not just aesthetics.</Tip>
